text.purpose:
This ITA supports a resource consent application for a mixed-use development.

It answers RMA s88(2)(b) & Schedule 4, and the tests in <E27>.
text.reason:
- E27.6.1.1 trips over threshold
- Parking infringement (E27.6.2)
- Access location (E27.6.4)
text.locality: The site is on the corner of "Main Road" and Side 2, 400 m from the town centre.
text.zoning: Operative AUP zone: Business - Mixed Use. Proposed PC120 rezoning to Residential - Terrace Housing.
text.active:
Footpaths on both sides.
Shared path along Main Road (west).
text.crash-narrative: Most crashes at the Main Road / Side 2 priority junction involve right-turning vehicles.
text.receiving: The Mill Road designation is included in the future baseline only where funded.
text.access: Two vehicle accesses: a left-in left-out on Side 2 and a full-movement access on Side 4.
text.parking: Parking is provided at 1 space per dwelling plus 12 visitor spaces.
text.staging: Build-out over three stages, each tied to the Side 2 upgrade.
text.construction: Construction traffic will use Main Road between 7:00 am and 5:00 pm.
text.walk: Pedestrian crossings are assessed against ANOP levels of service.
text.ssa: A Stage 1 Safe System Audit is recommended before detailed design.
text.alignment: The proposal aligns with Future Connect and the RLTP.
text.climate: No flood hazard affects the access routes.
text.mitigation: Signals at Side 2 are the preferred option; a roundabout was rejected on land take.
text.conditions: A condition requiring the Side 2 signals before the 200th dwelling is proposed.
text.monitoring: Travel plan monitoring one year after occupation.
text.conclusion: Effects are avoided, remedied or mitigated.
text.exec:
- Net 340 vehicle trips in the AM peak.
- Side 2 signals needed.
text.limitations: No SIDRA model was prepared for the Side 4 junction.
text.expert: The author has 15 years of experience in transport modelling.
text.scope: A moderate scope is proportionate: net peak trips are 340 veh/h and no state highway is involved.

M1.options: Roundabout; priority control with a right-turn bay
